selection: First chronological recorded observation per expected state with a matching native-size PNG and zero blocked controls. A terminal harness geometry failure for that state or a retained full geometry record with clipping disqualifies the observation. A completed state observation from a failed/partial journey is identified individually.
dataAvailability: Full native reachability rows retain total enabled/reachable counts, blocked controls, clipping, overflow and roll diagnostics. The native probe names controls only if they are blocked. No complete per-control identity roster is available for successful controls. Partial runs retain enabled/blocked counts, body size, and the printed roll metrics. Horizontal-clip diagnostics and scroll details were not serialized for those states.
result: Evidence from separate browser attempts. Combined coverage does not qualify an uninterrupted traversal.
